Encapsulation

Stage 5 Concept ⏱ 14 min 📖 Glossary

Hide the engine, show the steering wheel. Private fields + public methods keep objects valid even when callers are careless.

🔎 Motivating questionWhy can’t bank customers open the vault but can use the ATM?

Objectives

  • Make fields private
  • Write getters/setters
  • Validate inside setters

Needs first: The this Keyword

1 Start with an analogy

Real life first, code second.

Medicine bottle: child-proof cap (private) + measured spoon (public method). Direct handfuls blocked; safe doses allowed.

⚠️ Where the analogy breaksWhere it breaks: caps annoy adults too. Encapsulation needs well-designed methods — or users pry the cap (reflection/hacks).

2 The concept, plainly

One idea at a time, words before jargon.

private fields; public getters/setters: getTitle(), setPages(n) with checks.

Validate inside setters: reject negatives, clamp ranges. One guard protects all callers.

Expose behavior (borrow()), not raw flags.

3 Watch it move: Vault + ATM

Step at your pace. Text explains every move.

4 Live code demo

Small, correct Java 17 (LTS) code. Read, trace, copy.

Main.javaJava 17
class Book {
  private int pages;
  public int getPages() { return pages; }
  public void setPages(int p) {
    if (p > 0) pages = p;
  }
}
Book b = new Book();
b.setPages(-5);
b.setPages(200);
System.out.println(b.getPages());
▶ Output 200
  • pages hidden.
  • -5 rejected.
  • 200 accepted.
💡 Why this output?Setter guards; invalid ignored, valid stored.

6 Common mistakes (at least 3)

Wrong, why, fixed — learn from realistic slips.

❌ Mistake 1: public int pages; anyone sets -5Why: No guard.
✅ Fix: private + setter check.
❌ Mistake 2: Setter without checkWhy: Pointless wrapper.
✅ Fix: Add if (p > 0).
❌ Mistake 3: Getter returning mutable list directlyWhy: Callers mutate inside!
✅ Fix: Return copy/unmodifiable.

7 Guided practice

Hints first, solutions only after a real try.

Guard age

setAge allows 0..150 only.

Hintif in range assign.
Solutionif (a>=0 && a<=150) age=a;
Read-only?

Make title read-only.

HintGetter, no setter.
Solutionprivate title + getTitle only.

8 Lesson quiz

3+ questions. Attempts saved locally; review queue learns your weak spots.

9 Takeaways + next step

  • Hide fields, expose safe actions.
  • Validate once inside.
  • Read-only = getter only.
